wilds.name: WILD
wilds.behavior:
This symbol is WILD and substitutes for all symbols except for .
 WILD symbol is present only on reels 2, 3 and 4.
 Whenever a WILD hits, it will have a multiplier of 2x, 3x, or 5x.
 The WILD multiplier applies to the win of each payline that it is part of.
 If there is more than one WILD symbol part of the win of a payline, the
 multipliers of all WILD symbols on that payline are added to each other.

wilds.name: WILD
wilds.behavior:
FREE SPINS RULES
 The round starts with 8 free spins.
During the FREE SPINS ROUND, all WILD symbols that hit on reels 2, 3 or 4 remain on the screen for the whole
duration of the FREE SPINS ROUND. Sticky WILD symbols have a random multiplier which is revealed when the
 WILD hits and it remains the same until the end of the round.
 This is the SCATTER overlay symbol. During the FREE SPINS ROUND the
 can appear randomly on top of any symbol, including sticky WILD symbols.

scatters.name: SCATTER
scatters.behavior:
This is the SCATTER symbol. It appears only on reels 1, 3 and 5.
 Hit 3 SCATTER symbols on reels 1, 3 and 5 to trigger the FREE SPINS ROUND.

 If at the end of the FREE SPINS ROUND the total win is below 10x bet, a prize of 10x bet is awarded.
